title: A Space's emails wear its Mega Theme, not only Midnight's
detail: SYS-12 of the Mega Theme build plan. emailSurface now reads MEGA_SURFACES, so Bold, Wildheart, Network, Temple and Designer seed their emails from their own token set, as Midnight already did. The owner's exact words rewrote the email-colors pin that held every other theme on the house palette; the default theme keeps it. pageSurface is unchanged: a Space page or event page still takes Midnight's ground only (theme fence).

verify.evidence: vitest lib/spaces/email-colors.test.ts passes: temple email canvas is its own, frequency keeps the house palette.
